theorem sub_re (z w : ℂ) : (z - w).re = z.re - w.re :=
  rfl

theorem normSq_sub (z w : ℂ) : normSq (z - w) = normSq z + normSq w - 2 * (z * conj w).re := by
  rw [sub_eq_add_neg, normSq_add]
  simp only [map_neg, mul_neg, neg_re, normSq_neg]
  ring

lemma normSq_eq_norm_sq (z : ℂ) : normSq z = ‖z‖ ^ 2 := by
  simp [norm_def, sq, Real.mul_self_sqrt (normSq_nonneg _)]

protected theorem sq_norm (z : ℂ) : ‖z‖ ^ 2 = normSq z := (normSq_eq_norm_sq z).symm

@[inherit_doc]
scoped[ComplexConjugate] notation "conj" => starRingEnd _

/-- This is not a simp lemma, since we usually want simp to keep `starRingEnd` bundled.
For example, for complex conjugation, we don't want simp to turn `conj x`
into the bare function `star x` automatically since most lemmas are about `conj x`. -/
theorem starRingEnd_apply (x : R) : starRingEnd R x = star x := rfl

/-- **Cauchy-Schwarz inequality** for finsets, squared version. -/
lemma sum_mul_sq_le_sq_mul_sq [CommSemiring R] [LinearOrder R] [IsStrictOrderedRing R]
    [ExistsAddOfLE R] (s : Finset ι)
    (f g : ι → R) : (∑ i ∈ s, f i * g i) ^ 2 ≤ (∑ i ∈ s, f i ^ 2) * ∑ i ∈ s, g i ^ 2 :=
  sum_sq_le_sum_mul_sum_of_sq_le_mul s
    (fun _ _ ↦ sq_nonneg _) (fun _ _ ↦ sq_nonneg _) (fun _ _ ↦ (mul_pow ..).le)
